concerns.text: T013 (Feature Computation) is listed as a parallel task [P] but explicitly depends on T015 (Edge Case Handling) and T012 (Anomaly List). T015 is also marked [P] but T013's description states 'Must be completed before T013' for T015. This creates a circular or invalid parallel ordering. T015 must precede T013, and T013 cannot be parallel with T015.

T014 (Dataset Merger) is marked [P] but depends on T012 (Anomaly List) and T013 (Features). T013 depends on T015. The 'Parallel Example' section incorrectly suggests T011, T012, T013, T015 can run together. T013 and T014 are strictly sequential consumers of T012/T015 outputs.

T029 (Paired t-test) is marked [P] but depends on T026a (Learned Baseline per-doc) and T027 (Static per-doc). T026a and T027 are implementation tasks. The 'Parallel Example' logic does not apply here; T029 is a strict consumer of T026a/T027 outputs and cannot run in parallel with them.

T031 (Falsifiability Check) is marked [P] but depends on T026b (Learned Mean), T027b (Static Mean), and T031a (Threshold Config). T026b depends on T026a. T027b depends on T027. T031 cannot be parallel with T026b/T027b/T031a. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T033 (Cross-Model Validation) is marked [P] but depends on T020 (Rules) and T033a (Gemma GT). T020 is in Phase 4. T033a is in Phase 5. T033 cannot run in parallel with T020 or T033a. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T015 is listed as 'Implementation for User Story 1' but placed after T012 and before T013 in the list, yet marked [P]. The text says 'Must be completed before T013', implying a sequential dependency. The [P] tag contradicts the explicit dependency text.
